The training began with the absolute basics—understanding the controls, maintaining balance, maintaining proper body posture, and developing road awareness. Bharti Ma'am explained every single detail with immense patience. What I appreciated most about her teaching style was the emphasis she placed on safety. Roshni Ma'am is extremely patient, and she always points out our mistakes; yet, she does so in a manner that enables you to correct those errors and foster your own progress. The way she guided me during the first 10 to 12 days was truly commendable; her greatest strength lies in her ability to boost a person's self-confidence. There is a certain firmness in her instructions—a quality that proves particularly beneficial for students who are a bit nervous or hesitant by nature.

In just 20 to 25 days, I began riding the scooter independently. After that, we went over the traffic rules, and occasionally—while observing the vehicles passing by on the highway—we would engage in lighthearted conversation, as our training venue is situated right alongside the main road. I was extremely eager to learn how to ride a scooter, and she was just as enthusiastic about teaching me.

Speaking of the coordination within their team—they are truly exceptional in this regard. Their colleagues are always prompt and ever-ready to offer help and guidance. They keep a keen eye on exactly where students are making mistakes, providing assistance at every stage. Their entire team is truly dedicated and conscientious.

When I first started my classes, I was quite nervous; being short in height , I had always harbored a fear of riding. However, "Ma'am" showed immense faith in me.

In just 20 to 25 days, I became proficient at riding the scooter. Ma'am and I even rode the scooter together (double-seat) on the highway. I felt a bit apprehensive at first; however, she bolstered my confidence so firmly that my fear vanished completely. Sitting behind me, she guided me, boosted my self-assurance, and corrected my mistakes throughout the entire journey. It felt exactly as if a voice right behind you were giving you instructions:

Thank you for teaching me, Bharti Ma'am. You are best ❤️
